fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShipLocalGate' shows, with CI unstable and a gate that counts its runs: the gate runs once on a head; a new commit changing only .rhiza/ files (a rendered file and a log entry) passes at once with a reason naming the earlier passing head and the gate not run again; a commit changing a file outside .rhiza/ runs it again; a changed rhiza.ship.localGate runs it again on the same tree; a dirty worktree runs it and records nothing; a ship state written before this change (Gated head only, no tree) still reads and reruns the gate once
fields.statement: A passing local gate records, in the ship state beside the head it passed on, the gate command and the hash of that head's tree with the top-level .rhiza/ entry left out, and rhiza ship gate passes at once without running the gate when the worktree is clean and its HEAD has the same command and the same non-.rhiza/ tree, so render, log-entry and model-only merge commits never rerun it while any change outside .rhiza/ or a changed gate command does

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShipLocalGate' shows a gate command that prints its environment receiving RHIZA_GATE_HEAD equal to the worktree's HEAD and RHIZA_GATE_BASE equal to git merge-base HEAD origin/main, and an empty RHIZA_GATE_BASE in a repo with no origin/main; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/describe-golden' passes with the ship.gate summary naming both variables
fields.statement: rhiza ship gate runs the project's gate command with RHIZA_GATE_BASE (the merge-base of HEAD with origin/main) and RHIZA_GATE_HEAD (the commit it checks) in its environment, RHIZA_GATE_BASE empty when no merge-base can be found, so a project's own gate command can check only what the branch changes while Rhiza stays language-neutral

fields.acceptance: The gate script has a dry-run mode printing the commands it would run, and go test -trimpath ./tools/... (or the script's own test, run by the builder) shows for a temporary repo: a change to one internal package lists go test for it and its reverse dependencies only and make self-check; a change only under .rhiza/ lists make self-check only; a change to go.mod or an empty RHIZA_GATE_BASE lists the full make test; a changed cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/foo.txtar with a leaf acceptance naming TestScripts/bar lists -run 'TestScripts/(foo|bar)$'; grep shows AGENTS.md naming git config rhiza.ship.localGate 'make gate'
fields.statement: Rhiza's own repo has a scoped gate (make gate, running a script under tools/) that, from RHIZA_GATE_BASE, runs go test -trimpath on the Go packages the branch changes and their reverse dependencies (cmd/rhiza's TestScripts limited to the changed txtar files and those named TestScripts/<name> in the leaf acceptance checks of RHIZA_CHANGE), then make self-check, under the machine-wide test lock, and falls back to make test plus make self-check when the base is empty or go.mod, go.sum, the Makefile, the gate script or cmd/rhiza/main_test.go changed; AGENTS.md says to set rhiza.ship.localGate to 'make gate'
